entries.primary_text: Talking here was my daughter's husband.

entries.canonical_text: said Takehiro's spirit through the medium. "My wife said, 'Take me anywhere.' Then she pointed at me. 'Kill that man.' "He pushed her away and asked me whether she should live or die. For that, I almost forgave him. But she fled. He cut one rope and left. "I rose from the cedar and picked up the small dagger she had dropped. I stabbed myself in the chest. "The thicket fell silent. Then someone crept towards me on soft feet. An unseen hand quietly drew the dagger from my chest.
entries.primary_text: said Takahiro's spirit through the medium. My wife said, Take me anywhere. Then she pointed at me. Kill that man. He pushed her away and asked me whether she should live or die. For that, I almost forgave him, but she fled. He cut one rope and left. I rose from the cedar and picked up the small dagger she had dropped. I stabbed myself in the chest. The thicket fell silent. Then someone crept towards me on soft feet. An unseen hand quietly drew the dagger from my chest.
